title: Umar's Change of Heart
paragraphs: Sebelum menjadi salah satu sahabat yang paling setia dalam Islam, Umar bin Khattab dikenal karena kuat menentang komunitas Muslim awal, pernah berangkat dengan niat jelas untuk menghadapi Nabi ﷺ secara langsung. Dalam perjalanannya, ia mengetahui bahwa saudarinya sendiri diam-diam telah memeluk keyakinan itu, dan amarahnya membawanya ke rumah saudarinya, di mana ia mendengar saudarinya dengan tenang membaca ayat-ayat Al-Qur'an.

Sesuatu tentang mendengar kata-kata itu secara langsung, alih-alih melalui gambaran dari orang lain, mengubah sesuatu dalam dirinya yang tidak ia duga, membuatnya meminta untuk membaca teks itu sendiri. Momen ini menandai perubahan arah total bagi Umar, yang kemudian menjadi salah satu sahabat yang paling berpengaruh dan sangat dihormati dalam seluruh komunitas Muslim awal.
answerKey: Before becoming one of Islam's most devoted companions, Umar ibn al-Khattab was known for strongly opposing the early Muslim community, once setting out with clear intentions to confront the Prophet ﷺ directly. On his way, he learned that his own sister had secretly embraced the faith, and his anger led him to her house, where he heard her quietly reciting verses from the Quran. Something about hearing those words directly, rather than through secondhand descriptions from others, shifted something in him that he had not expected, leading him to request to read the text himself. This moment marked a complete change in direction for Umar, who went on to become one of the most influential and deeply respected companions in the entire early Muslim community.
